subject: Resale certificate transfer for acquired subsidiary - EIN mismatch
messages:
From: Susan Martin <susan.martin@acadia-retail.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com
Cc: tax@acadia-retail.com
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Resale certificate for Beacon (post-acquisition EIN change)

Hi Vivek,

We completed the acquisition of Beacon Home Goods (previously Beacon LLC) in June and the business is now operating under Acadia Retail’s EIN. Our tax team found that Beacon’s existing resale certificate on file with you is tied to the old EIN (EIN: 12-3456789). Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept a transfer/continuation of the resale certificate to Acadia Retail (EIN: 98-7654321) or whether we need to submit a new state resale certificate?

Attached: Beacon_Resale_2024.pdf (signed resale certificate for Beacon LLC)

If possible, we’d like to avoid invoice holds for outstanding Q2 charges while we get paperwork in order. We can provide:
- Asset Purchase Agreement showing the transfer of business
- A DocuSign-signed transfer acknowledgement from Acadia
- New signed state resale certificate as soon as it’s processed (some states are taking 2–3 weeks)

What documentation does Redwood require in this situation to accept the exemption under the new EIN? Please advise and also let us know if you can release any invoices currently on hold pending this documentation.

Thanks,
Susan Martin
Director, Sales & Use Tax
Acadia Retail
susan.martin@acadia-retail.com
From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com
To: Susan Martin <susan.martin@acadia-retail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Resale certificate for Beacon (post-acquisition EIN change)

Hi Susan — thanks for the context and the attached certificate. Short answer: we can accept the exemption under the new EIN but Finance needs a small package to allow us to map the existing certificate to Acadia and release invoices. Two paths would work: 

Option A (preferred, fastest):
- DocuSign-signed transfer confirmation from Acadia (explicitly referencing Beacon LLC certificate and the new EIN)
- Copy of the Asset Purchase Agreement showing the transfer of assets/business (redacted for sensitive terms is fine)
- A copy of the new state-issued resale certificate when available (can follow)

Option B (temporary, for immediate invoice release):
- Signed letter on Acadia letterhead stating that Acadia has acquired Beacon and will assume resale status for the referenced EIN/certificate; includes both EINs and signature of an authorized officer
- Beacon’s signed resale certificate (attached)
- Finance will place an administrative note on the account for 60 days and will review when the new state certificate arrives

If you can provide the signed DocuSign transfer and the APA, we can get Finance to clear invoices for the acquisition month. I’m looping in Marissa (billing) and Karthik (tax ops) to confirm required fields and any state-specific quirks.

Action items for Acadia: please send the DocuSign link (or signed PDF) and the APA. If you prefer Option B for a quick release, we need the signed letter and we will flag the account accordingly.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com
From: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Resale certificate for Beacon (post-acquisition EIN change)

Vivek — noted. Finance policy we’ll apply here:
- Accept DocuSign transfer + APA as full evidence to map exemption to the new EIN and release any invoice holds up to 60 days retroactive.
- If we only get a signed letter (Option B), release is discretionary and limited to current invoices; legal may request follow-up if the state questions the transfer.
- Please include the state(s) where Beacon operates (we need to track state-by-state acceptance).

Karthik — once we have the DocuSign and APA, Finance will clear the invoices and add the new EIN to the exemption database. Can you confirm whether we need any additional language for CA, TX, or WA?

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Asset_Purchase_Agreement_Acadia_Beacon.pdf, DocuSign_Transfer_Acadia.pdf
DocuSign link: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=12345&formId=abcde-12345

States with active Beacon sales: CA, WA, TX.

Please let us know once Finance has cleared the invoice hold for June and July billings (invoice IDs: INV-2026-1642, INV-2026-1709). We’re aiming to close our month-end cash allocations by EOW.

Let me know if you need any redactions on the APA before you store it.

Best,
Susan
